title: feat(scenarios)!: cards declare user-handle fields and persona records; seed dependence is decided per turn
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4Jt9kqe7MNvcC7UcRXr6hv)_

Fixes #30914

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the published card schema (`ScenarioCardSchema`, `.` entry) gains `run.userHandleFields` and `personas[].record`; the loader refuses cards it loaded before (a scope rule ending on an undeclared field, a scoped persona naming no person); `./runner`'s `seedDependence` takes the loaded scenario and asks per turn.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or docs page teaches the scenario card format; its own documentation, `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`, is updated here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景卡片格式新增两项声明——`run.userHandleFields`(哪些种子字段的值是"用户句柄",如 `account.owner = u_sam`)与 `personas[].record`(有行范围的角色对应哪一条种子行,如员工 `e06`);加载器拒收"范围规则落在既非句柄、也非查找/选项/`id` 的字段上"以及"有范围却没指明是谁"的卡;跑测记录新增 `seed.rewritten`;种子行被应用拒收时,只把"预期答案因此改变"的那几轮问答记为未测,其余照常评分。
- 为什么改:句柄字段原来靠推断,新卡可能被悄悄写错种子;一行被拒就整对象作废,遮掉了本可评分的结果(#30882 契约复审的 S1、S2);`record` 是维护者 2026-11-07 13:34 对 #30913 裁决的卡片格式那一半(S3)。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@objectstack/scenarios`(QA 工具包)与九张卡;九张卡全部照常加载,种子改写的字段集合与改前完全相同(`account.owner`、`invoice.owner`、`task.assignee`);私有覆盖目录里的卡若没有这两项声明会被拒收,补声明即可。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts`(新拒收与 `truthsOver`)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts`(`seedDependence` 按轮判断)、`docs/qa/scenarios/service_desk.json`(三个角色的 `record`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/refusals.test.ts test/runner/units.test.ts`,预期全绿;其中 ct4 用例显示 `contacts_per_account` 以 `sdr` 身份仍被评分。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**S2 — user-handle fields are declared.**
- `run.userHandleFields: [{ object, field }]` (optional, at least one entry) lists the seed fields whose text stands for a user. `userHandleFields` in `src/runner/prompts.ts` now reads this list and nothing else; it no longer infers a handle from "a direct scope field that is no lookup or select".
- The loader refuses a persona `scope` rule whose last field (the last hop of a relation path) is not `id`, a declared lookup, a declared select or a declared handle field. It also refuses a handle declaration on the row id, a declared lookup, a declared select, an object the card does not seed, a field no seed row carries, and a duplicate.
- The run record's `seed.rewritten` lists each `object.field` the seed loaded with a user id in place of the handle text (`RunHalf.seed`, `src/runner/orchestrate.ts`).
- The three control cards declare their handle field. Before and after, measured over the nine cards: before (`origin/main`, inferred) `crm_account_with_contacts:account.owner`, `invoice_with_line_items:invoice.owner`, `project_with_tasks:task.assignee`; after (declared) the same three.

**S1 — seed dependence per turn.**
- `seedDependence(scenario, refused)` keeps its row walk (the refused rows plus their children through the declared lookups), then computes every truth again over the seed less those rows with `truthsOver` (new in `src/loader.ts`, the loader's own resolver, row-scope test and withheld rule, factored out as `seedReader` and `withholds`). `question(q, persona)` is not measured only when that turn's expected answer changes, or is no longer defined (`seed: its expected answer is not defined without …`).
- `runHalf` asks it per turn (inside the persona loop). Operations are unchanged.
- The ct4 case: refusing contact `ct4` on `crm_account_with_contacts` used to leave 5 turns not measured (`contacts_per_account/sdr`, `unattached_contacts`, `best_covered_account`, `tech_contacts`, `contacts_by_industry`); it now leaves 2 (`unattached_contacts`, `contacts_by_industry`, the two whose answer ct4 changes). `contacts_per_account` as `sdr` stays measured.

**S3 — `personas[].record = { object, id }`.**
- Required on a persona with a `scope`, unless that persona is named by a direct scope rule on a declared handle field; optional on a global persona. The loader refuses a record naming no seeded row (including a row of an object the card does not seed). `PERSON_USER_FIELD = 'user'` fixes the person object's user field by name.
- Filled on the six cards the ruling names: `asset_lifecycle` (employee e06, dept_manager e05), `leave_balances` (e07, e05), `order_to_cash` (e03, e01), `requisition_to_receipt` (e02, e13), `travel_expense` (e02, e01), `service_desk` (agent a02, agent a04, customer cus_03). Each id is the one the persona's `role` already names.
- Format and loader only: the runner does not read `record` (#30913's half).

**Namespacing and docs.** `namespacedScenario` (`src/runner/namespace.ts`) prefixes the object of each handle declaration and each `record`. `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` documents both declarations and the new refusals; the package README documents per-turn dependence and `seed.rewritten`. One `patch` changeset.

## Tests

- `test/refusals.test.ts`: 12 new refusal pins (one refusal each, exact path) and two controls: a scoped persona naming its record (and a global persona naming one) loads clean; deleting `run.userHandleFields` from the crm card refuses both of `sdr`'s scope rules and its missing person. The gallery-floor fixture now scopes its second persona on a declared select and names its record.
- `test/runner/units.test.ts`: `userHandleFields` reads the declaration (a card declaring none has none); across the nine cards the handle set is the three fields and every record is pinned; `seedDependence` per turn on the ac1 case, the ct4 case and a truth the rest of the seed no longer defines.
- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: `seed.rewritten` in the record; the ct4 run (7/7 measured, 2 not measured; the driver is asked `contacts_per_account` as `sdr`); the all-accounts-refused run keeps the three turns no account feeds, and a half with every turn not measured is still `not-run`.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed HEAD `33a20989`: mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob changed), suite red, restored to the HEAD blob; `git diff HEAD` empty after all legs. The tests import `src/` directly (no `dist/` in the path), so no rebuild leg.

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | scope rule ending on an undeclared field not refused | 2 failed (the refusal pin; the no-declaration test) |
| A2 | handle declared on a lookup, select or id not refused | 3 failed (the three pins) |
| A3 | handle on an unseeded object not refused | 1 failed |
| A4 | handle field no seed row carries not refused (`checkField` call deleted) | 1 failed |
| A5 | duplicate handle declaration not refused | 1 failed |
| A6 | record naming no seeded row not refused | 2 failed (row missing; object unseeded) |
| A7 | scoped persona with no person not refused | 2 failed (the pin; the no-declaration test) |
| A8 | per-turn comparison removed (every turn on an out row not measured) | 4 failed (both runCard dependence tests, both units dependence tests) |
| A9 | `seed.rewritten` not recorded | 2 failed (both seed-record pins) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Reading of "required for a persona with a scope".** The S3 ruling says required for a scoped persona; the #30913 ruling (Q1 = A′, item 5) keeps the user-handle route for crm, invoice and project, whose scoped personas are users with no person row. Both hold here: `record` is required unless the persona is named by a direct scope rule on a declared handle field. On the nine cards that is exactly the three controls.
- **Global personas carry no record.** It is optional for them and the ruling names only the scoped ones; whether #30913's owner rule wants one on `asset_admin`, `hr_officer` and the like is that card's call.
- **The terminal-field rule reads the last hop of a path.** `contact.account.owner` ends on `account.owner`, a declared handle; `order_line.order.owner.team` ends on `employee.team`, a declared select. The card's wording is "a scope on a field"; reading only direct rules would leave a path ending on an undeclared field to inference, which is what S2 removes.
- **File surface.** `src/runner/namespace.ts` is outside the claim's list: without it the namespaced card the runner reads keeps bare object names in the two new keys and `userHandleFields` answers `account.owner` where the seed loop looks for `democrm_account.owner`. `src/runner/seed.ts` needed no change. `orchestrate.ts` changes `seedDependence`, its caller in `runHalf`, the `RunHalf.seed` type and one line of the seed loop (`rewritten`).
- **Serial with #31159.** No change to `runner/driver.ts` or `runner/cli.ts`. `origin/main` moved by two commits since the branch point, neither in `packages/qa/scenarios`.

## Verification

- Heads: code and tests at `33a20989`; `4b4df50a` adds one sentence to the changeset only. The derived loop started on `33a20989`; the changeset-reading gates were run again on `4b4df50a` (below). Base `bdefd49f`; `origin/main` has moved two commits since, neither in `packages/qa/scenarios`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run`: Test Files 28/28, Tests 571/571 (after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0, and the package's own build, which `test/build/*` read).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, its program includes `test/**`): exit 0.
- `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages/qa/scenarios --no-inline-config` (the root `pnpm lint`, scoped; the package has no lint script): exit 0.
- On `4b4df50a`: `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` with this body as the event: exit 0 ("`yes (narrowing)` and metadata-protocol `none` … a non-protocol change at `patch`"); `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0 (the `no-migration-prescription` disposition read); `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0; `check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` with `PR_BODY` set to this body: exit 0.
- **Not measured:** a live model run (paused by the maintainer) and a recorded-driver replay (no recording in this container); the per-turn rule is pinned on the real crm card through the fake-app `runCard` tests instead.
